content.short: Polychain Capital is a San Francisco-based venture capital firm investing in cryptocurrency and blockchain.
content.description: Polychain Capital is a San Francisco–based venture capital firm that concentrates on cryptocurrency and blockchain technology investments. Founded in 2016 by Olaf Carlson-Wee, who previously served as Head of Risk at Coinbase, Polychain has supported a range of projects and teams shaping the digital asset ecosystem. The firm counts prominent investors such as Sequoia Capital, Union Square Ventures, and Founders Fund among its backers, underscoring its long-standing involvement in crypto finance and technology ventures.
